ITI ELECTRICIAN (FRESHER)

Location: Metoda, Rajkot

Phone: +91 7383931483

Email: vaghelarahul392@gmail.com

CAREER OBJECTIVE

A dedicated ITI Electrician fresher seeking an entry-level position to apply basic electrical knowledge, wiring skills,

and safety principles while gaining practical experience in industrial and domestic electrical operations.

EDUCATION & QUALIFICATION

ITI Electrician

NCVT Board

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Basic House & Industrial Wiring (Single-Phase & Three-Phase)

Knowledge of Switchboards, MCBs, and Control Panel Wiring

Motor connection, Starters (AC/DC) & Transformer basics

Testing instruments: Multimeter, Megger & Tester

Electrical Safety Rules & Earthing Installation

PRACTICAL TRAINING / ITI WORKSHOP

Completed practical training on circuit connections, lighting systems, and distribution boards during ITI

coursework.

Handled basic testing, motor connections, and fault identification in laboratory exercises.

Followed workplace safety guidelines and standard precautions during practical work.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Full Name Rahul Vaghela

Date of Birth 05-03-1997

Gender Male

Current Location Metoda, Rajkot

Languages Known Gujarati, Hindi
